versionImpact.rationale: This pre-stable maintainer-authorized refinement compresses KFD-1 through KFD-6 into their normative core, aligns every title with its one-sentence decision, and separates authoritative constraints from explanatory usage and case material. KFD-5 states its central separation of genesis from qualification while preserving perspective-declared, method-plural schema version 3. The fixed outer package line remains v1.0; major remains the honest decision-surface impact.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: Before the first stable release, maintainer-authorized refinement compresses all six decision texts and their public titles while preserving prior prerelease artifacts. Normative gates remain in decisions; package mechanics and cases route to usage and companion documents. KFD-5 now foregrounds the separation of genesis from qualification while preserving its version 3 method-plural interface. Consumers must bind prerelease citations to package version or commit.
registry.json keeps schemaVersion 1 and the existing entry shape, including number, id, slug, title, kind, status, path, and url; slug and path values are stable number coordinates.

KFD-4 keeps its version 1 perspective interfaces. KFD-5 primitiveDiscovery advances from schemaVersion 2 to 3, replacing mandatory perspectiveGenesis with perspective-declared method-plural genesis. Draft KFD-6 advances from schemaVersion 3 to 4, replacing mandatory perspectiveExperiments with plural generationExperiments and methodComparison while keeping boundaryHypothesis conditional.

The package additively publishes schemas/kfd-4/perspective-replay.schema.json and docs/primitive-discovery-cases.md through existing wildcards, and strengthens expected release artifacts without removing or renaming a package path or export.

KFD now uses Buildchain v2 floating workflow refs with a consumer-owned buildchain.contract-lock.json, so Buildchain runtime contract drift is checked before heavy build or promotion work while retaining floating-ref upgrade flow.

site/kfd-site.json preserves existing fields while adding the /foundation and /cases routes, foundationPage and casesPage projections, a primitive-first futurePicture, and explicit first-screen/detail separation.

KFD-4/5/6 usage bodies explain observer-bound timelines, perspective-preserving and contrastive replay, method-plural genesis, fact-bound qualification, and autonomous method comparison while stable /N/usage routes remain unchanged.

KFD refreshes pre-build and artifact-side KFD-3 witnesses to include the participant-consumable perspective replay schema, the updated foundation explanation, and the source-bound historical cases companion.
KFD-3 collaboration interfaces now declare explicit valueEvidence that binds participant-facing value claims to fact artifacts, evidence artifacts, KFD-2 trust assessments, and residual-risk state.
KFD now ships an explicit machine-bound public KFD-2 release trust claim and passes it into Buildchain release passport generation.

KFD-2 generic trust claims identify KFD-4 timeline and replay profiles, KFD-5 version 3 method-plural genesis, and KFD-6 version 4 method-comparison experiments while continuing to downgrade KFD-6 because no adopter has proved the draft autonomous capability or a dominant genesis method.

Decision documents now use stable numbered paths under decisions/KFD-N.md, while usage documentation uses docs/KFD-N-usage.md to distinguish authoritative decision text from consumer implementation notes.
KFD now declares its package version through an anchored/manual release manifest so package version state is an explicit release fact rather than an auto-derived Buildchain side effect.

The KFD to site-libkungfu-dev propagation graph now targets the downstream site's actual main branch and documents the exact KFD package surfaces consumed by kfd.libkungfu.dev, without changing the release propagation graph contract.
KFD-1 now defines breaking, additive, none, and unclassifiable as the generic compatibility-impact core, with release versioning as one projection rather than the only interpretation.
standards.json additively registers the KFD-4 perspective replay schema as an integration-time surface, and the KFD-1 witness binds its source and artifact digest from that fact source.

KFD-4 additively publishes a version 1 contract for perspective-preserving and contrastive replay, including source-view boundaries, reconstruction loss, degraded state, and primitive-signal mismatches.

KFD-1 now publishes a machine-readable schema for canonical reader URLs, latest aliases, immutable version artifact URLs, artifact digests, source coordinates, lineage, site consumption, and archive policies that prevent same-version digest drift or destructive deletion of immutable publication prefixes.

summary: KFD v1.0 records a pre-stable major editorial and decision-surface refinement with immutable prior artifacts: six concise authoritative decisions retain their gates and boundaries while implementation, self-proof, and case detail route to companion surfaces.
